title: review follow-ups of PR #37714: swimlane kanban changelog line reads backwards; stale jsdocs; unpinned later-page gate and aggregates
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (review follow-ups, one card per PR) · Source: fleet (Contract review record 7205497529 on PR #37714, nits N1–N5, adopted at ACCEPT)

## What happens

PR #37714 (Fixes #37326) draws the lane-foot statistic on a kanban in swimlanes (one row under all lanes, one figure per column, equal to the flat board's) and reads whole column counts when the list hands over one page. Its review left these items open:

- [ ] **The changeset's last sentence can read backwards** (N1). "does not add the lanes …, as the flat board does" ships as CHANGELOG text. Expected before release: "unlike the flat board, which adds them".
- [ ] **Two stale jsdocs in `ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanImpl.tsx`** (N2). `KanbanBoardProps.laneCounts` still says "Drawn on the flat layout only"; the `LaneFootStatistic` jsdoc names a `SwimlaneFootRow` component that does not exist.
- [ ] **The swimlane later-page gate is unpinned** (N3). The now-explicit `!flatLanes` gate on `extraLaneIds` carries a stated decision (swimlanes do not append columns that only have records on later pages); pin it, ideally with #37517's work, which should also cover the swimlane layout.
- [ ] **Only sum and count are pinned on the swimlane foot** (N4). avg, min and max share the path; add one case each.
- [ ] **Swimlane row counts and per-cell figures stay page floors** (N5). On a self-querying windowed board, one two-key grouped read would make them whole and push the work to SQL.

Category ①: changelog wording and test/jsdoc gaps on a shipped board layout.
Priority: p3 (the PR's figures are correct; these are wording and coverage).
Business reason: a reader of the release notes could believe swimlane boards add later-page columns, and a future edit could break the swimlane foot's avg/min/max unnoticed.
Reader: the ux-lane dev who next edits the kanban plugin.
Dedupe: searched open issues for `"PR #37714"`: 0 hits.
Related: #37326, #37517, PR #37714.

## Grade

area:ux · Bug · minor · reach: read (the head against `main`) · evidence: read → p3
